Subject: Proposal for Redwood + Maple City partner panel (NYC, June)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick call yesterday — excited about partnering on the NYC partner panel on June 8. Attached is a high-level quote and line-item breakdown (MapleCity_Quote_NYC_Panel_2027-04-11.pdf). The total comes to $6,800 which covers:
- Venue & AV production: $3,800
- Travel stipends for 3 partner speakers: $2,000 ($666.67 each)
- Incidentals/contingency: $1,000

We typically require a 30% deposit to lock the date ($2,040). Payment options: card (pcard) for deposits <= $3,000, ACH/PO for larger amounts. We can provide a W9 and signed SOW on request.

Next steps from our side: if you confirm vendor, we will hold the venue and send a formal invoice for the deposit. Please let me know the PO details if Redwood prefers that route.

Best,
Jill Harper

Subject: Re: Proposal for Redwood + Maple City partner panel (NYC, June)

Hi team,

Thanks for the background. Finance rules for one-off event vendors in US:
- P-card can be used for single vendor charges <= $3,000.
- Any vendor engagement with total expected spend > $5,000 requires a Purchase Order (PO) and vendor onboarding (W9 + SOW).
- Deposits are allowed but will be netted against the PO/invoice; deposit >$3,000 needs PO.

Given the vendor quote of $6,800, we will need a PO for the full amount. Cost center and GL mapping below (please include on the PO request):
- Cost center: 4100-MKT-EVT-2027
- GL account: 62000 (Events & Sponsorships)

Required docs to create PO and expedite payment:
1) Vendor W9 (received).
2) Signed SOW or short statement of work (1 page).
3) Vendor contact and remit email (accounts@maplecity.com).

If you need the deposit sooner than the PO lead time, we can do a two-step: request an expedited PO (we can try to push to 5 business days) and issue a one-off p-card payment skewed to the $3k limit for the deposit if Jill confirms she can accept card for the deposit amount. Otherwise, we'll request a 30% deposit on PO terms.

Please confirm ASAP which way you'd like to proceed. If you want me to route an expedited PO, confirm the exact PO total ($6,800) and attach the SOW.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jill Harper <jill@yamamotoproductions.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal for Redwood + Maple City partner panel (NYC, June)

Monica — perfect, thanks for the quick clarity. We will proceed with a PO for the full $6,800 and request an expedited approval. Marissa — can you approved the PO total and route to Monica? We need to lock the venue today if possible.

Jill — can you confirm you can accept a 30% deposit via pcard up to $3,000 and take the remaining balance on PO terms? If yes we'll do: 1) pcard charge of $2,040 for deposit (MapleCity will refund difference if card < deposit), 2) PO for remaining $4,760 to be paid net 30 after event. Also attaching an invoice stub for the deposit (NYCPanel_invoice_stub_20270418.pdf).

Attached: invoice stub. Jill — if you can also send the 1-page SOW today we will attach to the PO request.

Thanks all — copying Vanessa to help coordinate speaker logistics.

— Logan
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
